newsitem.title: DUBAI: IOC, Banoco 1997 oil contract talks due next week.
newsitem.headline: IOC, Banoco 1997 oil contract talks due next week.

text.p: Indian Oil Corp (IOC) officials are due in Bahrain next week to negotiate 1997 term supplies of middle distillates from Bahrain National Oil Co (Banoco), Gulf oil industry sources said on Wednesday.
The talks are expected to focus on the renewal of this year's contract under which Banoco supplied just over 1.5 million tonnes of diesel and kersoene to IOC.
IOC also buys small quantities of fuel oil and gasoline from Banoco on a term basis.
IOC has already concluded term oil product agreements with Kuwait and Abu Dhabi and has also approached Saudi Aramco for supplies next year, traders said.
Traders are watching IOC's term talks closely to assess IOC's potential spot markets requirements next year.
